name: water_specific_semantic_temporal_specialist
purpose: Test whether a semantic temporal specialist can recognize active dripping or leaking water from short localized-motion candidate sequences that deterministic motion features alone could not classify.

candidate_selection.method: rank successfully stabilized frame pairs by localization_score
candidate_selection.rationale: Select relatively strong localized motion without introducing a hand-tuned positive/negative threshold.

implementation_details.candidate_time: current_frame.timestamp_seconds from the ranked B2 frame pair
implementation_details.temporal_separation: A candidate is accepted only when its timestamp is at least 2.0 seconds from every previously accepted candidate.
implementation_details.stopping_rule: Stop after 6 accepted candidates or after all ranked pairs have been examined.

temporal_context.frame_selection: closest available frame to each 0.25-second position from candidate_time-1.0 through candidate_time+1.0
temporal_context.presentation: one chronological contact sheet per candidate

implementation_details.nearest_frame_selection: For each requested time, select the available sampled frame with minimum absolute timestamp distance.
implementation_details.duplicate_frame_policy: Allow the same source frame only if clipping near the video boundary makes it the closest frame to multiple requested positions.
implementation_details.padding: black letterbox padding only; no cropping
implementation_details.annotation: candidate-relative timestamp and absolute video timestamp

prompt_policy.specialist_scope: active water leak or dripping water only
prompt_policy.positive_requires: visible evidence consistent with liquid water actively dripping, falling, streaming, leaking, or repeatedly emerging from a source across the temporal sequence
do_not_count: old water damage without active water
uncertain tiny motion with no visible liquid interpretation
prompt_policy.uncertainty_policy: If active water cannot be identified with reasonable visual confidence, return negative.
prompt_policy.exact_prompt:
You are a visual specialist evaluating short temporal image sequences for ACTIVE WATER ONLY.

You will receive several candidate contact sheets from one anonymous property-inspection video.

Each candidate is a 3x3 contact sheet.
Within each contact sheet, frames are chronological from left to right, top to bottom.
The timestamp text is diagnostic context only.

Your task is ONLY to determine whether any candidate contains visible evidence consistent with liquid water actively:
- dripping,
- falling,
- streaming,
- leaking, or
- repeatedly emerging from a source across the temporal sequence.

Do NOT count any of the following as active water:
- static stains,
- old water damage without active water,
- reflections,
- shadows,
- camera motion,
- compression artifacts,
- ordinary moving objects,
- uncertain tiny motion with no visible liquid interpretation.

Require temporal visual evidence that is reasonably interpretable as liquid water.

If active water cannot be identified with reasonable visual confidence, return negative.

Return ONLY one JSON object with exactly these fields:

{
  "active_water_detected": false,
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "candidate_index": null,
  "evidence": "short visual-evidence description"
}

Rules:
- active_water_detected must be true or false.
- confidence must be from 0 to 1.
- candidate_index must be the matching candidate number if positive, otherwise null.
- evidence must be concise and based only on visible evidence.
- Do not return Markdown.
- Do not add any fields.

methodology.classification_rule: Case is positive only when active_water_detected=true. No additional confidence threshold will be introduced after the run.
methodology.promotion_rule: Research evidence only. A successful B3 result may become a Detector v4 candidate component but must later be evaluated on a brand-new untouched holdout.

response_handling.markdown_fence_handling: strip one surrounding JSON/Markdown code fence without another model call
response_handling.invalid_json_policy: abort run immediately; do not retry model call
response_handling.positive_candidate_requirement: candidate_index must identify one supplied candidate
